title: Section C E6: the passthrough strategy swallows every wait() error, so a repriced replacement (same swap, higher fee) that mined is reported as landed-not-ours, and the buy path then reports a landed buy as a zero-spend failure

evidence.note: catch (waitErr) logs and sets nativeConfirmed false for every error; err.code, err.reason and err.receipt are not read
on a replacement wait() throws TRANSACTION_REPLACED with reason "repriced" (same data/to/value), "cancelled" or "replaced", carrying the replacement hash and its receipt
the reconcile then probes only the original hash: no receipt, nonce advanced -> landed-not-ours -> throw
responses from getTransaction() start with #startBlock -1, so no replacement detection; the slice only waits on sendTransaction responses (replaceable, abstract-provider.js:757)

sibling_sites_checked: The only wait() in the slice is passthrough.ts:140 (flashbots uses the library bundle.wait, bloXroute never waits). The status-0 case is handled correctly: the catch defers to reconcile, which reads receipt status 0 as reverted (reconciliation.ts:376-378). The exit-path sites (exitEngine.ts:422, :545, :556) are AUD-EXIT-010; the deliberate public buy (bot.ts:750) is part of AUD-BUY-025. A repricing can only come from outside the process (operator wallet "speed up", a second process AUD-TX-005, or an out-of-process script).
severity_rationale: S3, matching the exit-path twin AUD-EXIT-010: the condition needs an external replacement of the bot's own pending tx. When it happens on a buy, the landed buy reaches the snipe catch as a failure with no row (AUD-BUY-002 consequences); on a sell the no-double-sell guard stays capital-safe through the balance check. Section C candidate (no RC number), so origin research-candidate with an empty rc list.
recommendation: Phase 24 with card TX-01: classify wait() errors: on TRANSACTION_REPLACED use err.receipt (status 1 and reason repriced = our swap landed under the replacement hash; return that hash), on CALL_EXCEPTION report reverted, otherwise reconcile. Return the replacement hash to the caller so the trade row and receipt decoding use the hash that mined.
